verdict.rationale: uv is a command-line Python package and project manager with no graphical UI, so the question of whether its API matches its UI is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence describes only CLI commands, and the probe found no OpenAPI or web API. Its CLI is the single interface, so there is no UI–API split to measure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
